title: Brown's electrometers pick up anomalies matching the sidereal calendar, run up to the end of his life on Catalina

tellings.quote: One of the things he did was build these devices that he called electrometers and they were receiving maybe neutrinos.

plain: Thomas Townsend Brown, a scientist the episode calls a CIA scientist who built flying-saucer-like devices, is said to have built instruments he called electrometers that picked up odd signals following the sidereal calendar, time kept by the stars rather than the sun, and possibly caught neutrinos, tiny particles that pass through almost everything. A woman named Linda Brown tells this in a documentary episode about him, passing on what he told her, and says he ran these devices up to the end of his life on Catalina Island, California, around 1985. If true, his instruments were sensing something coming from space.
